name: Fixes
author: byo-pop
description: Mends the small faults of the original and changes nothing else: the same gems, rules, scores, sounds and pace. Each fix is a toggle; turn the whole mod off to play the original as it was. Shares the original's high scores.

settings.label: A replay's rewind hides the board's effects
settings.help: When a best move's replay rewinds, the original hides the board's own drawing but still draws its floating, mirrored and smoothly turning pictures over the rewind. This hides them with the rest.
